data.name: Measure
data.comment: Link under the note and date in the note sheet that opens the fields for height, width and the rest. It is a command.

data.name: MeasureGroup
data.comment: Name of the group of measurement fields, read out by a screen reader.

data.name: MeasureHint
data.value: Leave out what you did not measure.
data.comment: Small line over the measurement fields.

data.name: AddMeasurements
data.comment: Button in the note sheet that saves measurements typed with no note and no photos.

data.name: FieldError
data.comment: Error under the measurement fields. {0} is the name of the kind, like Height.

data.name: AddKind
data.comment: Link under the measurement fields that shows a form for a kind of measurement of your own, like nodes.

data.name: KindName
data.comment: Label of the box for the name of a new kind of measurement.

data.name: KindNamePlaceholder
data.comment: Example in the box for the name of a new kind of measurement.

data.name: KindMeasuredAs
data.comment: Label over the choice between Length and Count when adding a kind of measurement.

data.name: KindLength
data.comment: A kind of measurement that is a length, in cm or inches.

data.name: KindCount
data.comment: A kind of measurement that is a number of things, like nodes.

data.name: KindAdd
data.comment: Button that saves a new kind of measurement.

data.name: TlKindMeasured
data.comment: Kind of an entry on the history: measurements were taken, with no note or photos.

data.name: GrowthTitle
data.comment: Small heading over the growth curves on a plant or cutting.

data.name: GrowthDescription
data.comment: Read out for a growth curve. {0} is the kind, like Height, {1} the number of measurements, {2} and {3} the first and last day or day count, {4} the latest value with its unit.

data.name: GrowthPoint
data.comment: Name of a point on a growth curve, which is a button that scrolls to the entry. {0} is the value, {1} the day.

data.name: PageTitle
data.comment: Title of the browser tab.

data.name: Title
data.comment: Heading of the page for your own kinds of measurement.

data.name: Hint
data.value: Height, width, leaves and root length are always there when you measure a plant or cutting. Here are the kinds you added yourself.

data.name: EmptyTitle
data.value: No kinds of your own yet.

data.name: EmptyText
data.value: Height, width, leaves and root length are always there. Add your own, like nodes or aerial roots, here or while you measure.

data.name: AddFirst
data.comment: Button on the page when there are no kinds of your own.

data.name: AddMore
data.comment: Button on the page above the list.

data.name: YourKinds
data.comment: Heading over the list of kinds you added.

data.name: SheetAdd
data.comment: Title of the sheet for a new kind.

data.name: SheetEdit
data.comment: Title of the sheet for a kind you added.

data.name: RemoveConfirm
data.value: Remove {0}? The measurements you already took keep their name.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the kind of measurement.

data.name: AlreadyHave
data.value: You already have {0}. Tap it in the list to change it.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the kind of measurement.

data.name: RowLength
data.comment: Line under a kind in the list: it is a length.

data.name: RowCount
data.comment: Line under a kind in the list: it is a count.

data.name: RowUsed_One
data.comment: Line under a kind in the list. {0} is Length or Count, {1} is how many measurements use it.

data.name: RowUnused
data.comment: Line under a kind in the list. {0} is Length or Count.

data.name: KindFixed
data.value: It stays a {0} so the measurements already taken keep their meaning.
data.comment: Small line in the sheet of a kind you added. {0} is the word length or count.

data.name: KindFixedLength
data.comment: Fills {0} in the line that says the kind stays a length.

data.name: KindFixedCount
data.comment: Fills {0} in the line that says the kind stays a count.

data.name: Loading
data.comment: Shown while the kinds load.
